data.name: Privacy_Local
data.value: Yamori never connects to the internet. Records stay on this PC.

data.name: Privacy_OneDrive
data.value: Yamori itself never connects to the internet. Records are saved in your OneDrive folder and synced by the OneDrive app.

data.name: Privacy_Custom
data.value: Yamori never connects to the internet. Records are saved in the folder you chose.

data.name: Storage_Fallback
data.value: The location you chose isn't available right now, so records are being saved on this PC.

data.name: Settings_AccountDescription
data.value: Signed in with your Windows account. Nothing is sent outside this PC.

data.name: Settings_StorageDescription
data.value: Choose where usage records are saved. Existing records are copied to the new location, and the originals are kept.

data.name: Settings_StorageLocalNote
data.value: Records stay only on this PC.

data.name: Settings_OneDriveNotFound
data.value: No OneDrive folder was found. Sign in to the OneDrive app to use this option.

data.name: Settings_OneDriveNote
data.value: With OneDrive, the OneDrive app syncs your records to the cloud. Each PC gets its own folder, so records from different PCs don't mix.

data.name: Settings_LanguageDescription
data.value: The language Yamori uses on screen.

data.name: Settings_AboutDescription
data.value: An offline, open-source PC manager. Yamori uses only what Windows provides and never sends data outside your PC.
